title: Home Mortgage Loans Recast Schedule by Program
content:
Whether the installment on a Home Mortgage Loans note may be re-amortized after a large principal curtailment, the curtailment total the program calls for, and the fee the program carries for it are set out program by program below.

| Program | Re-amortization after a large curtailment | Curtailment total since the last re-amortization called for | Fee |
|---|---|---|---|
| FHA 30-Year Fixed Mortgage | not offered | not applicable | not applicable |
| VA 30-Year Fixed Mortgage | not offered | not applicable | not applicable |
| Conventional 30-Year Fixed Mortgage | offered | $10000.00 | $250.00 |
| Conventional 15-Year Fixed Mortgage | offered | $10000.00 | $250.00 |
| 7/6 SOFR Adjustable-Rate Mortgage | not offered | not applicable | not applicable |
| Jumbo 30-Year Fixed Mortgage | offered | $50000.00 | $500.00 |

## Notes to the schedule

Three of the six programs carry the figures: both Conventional programs at a curtailment total of $10000.00 and a fee of $250.00, and the Jumbo 30-Year Fixed Mortgage at a curtailment total of $50000.00 and a fee of $500.00. The FHA 30-Year Fixed Mortgage, the VA 30-Year Fixed Mortgage and the 7/6 SOFR Adjustable-Rate Mortgage carry no curtailment total and no fee, re-amortization not being offered on them.

The curtailment total in the middle column is measured since the last re-amortization on that loan.
